summary: Iter90 end-to-end frontend verification PASSED for all four P0 Photos bug fixes plus regression. Verified live on the deployed preview URL using admin@clubhaven.app. (1) Photos URL routing: after logging in and opening the '5-Year Anniversary' album the URL becomes /photos/20ab1328-9a7c-44aa-b6f4-892e174e87b2; a hard reload keeps the user on the same album URL with the title + 2 photos still visible (no kick back to /photos grid). The 'back-to-albums' button correctly returns to /photos. (2) Multi-photo upload: dispatched 3 small PNG files into the 'Bug Fix Test' album via the photos-multi-input. Network captured exactly 3 sequential POST /api/photos calls (all 200), the upload button text progressed through 'Uploading 0/3…' → 'Uploading 1/3…' → 'Upload photos' confirming sequential single-file uploads. /api/auth/logout was NEVER called during upload; /api/auth/me returned 200 immediately after; the user stayed on the album page (no Cloudflare parse error, no logout). (3) Zip download: clicking download-album-btn on the 5-Year Anniversary album triggered a streaming POST /api/photos/download-zip and produced aop-5-Year Anniversary.zip (60017 bytes, 2 valid JPEG entries: 'Unload 3.jpeg', 'Unload 4.jpeg'). (4) Optimistic logout: opening nav-user-menu and clicking menu-logout transitioned the UI to the logged-out shell in ~120 ms, with the /api/auth/logout call resolving in parallel (fire-and-forget). Visiting /photos while logged out correctly redirected to /login. Regression: back-to-albums, album cards, album-card testids, photo cards, and route protection all behave as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Photos.jsx L54-97: openAlbum/closeAlbum drive activeAlbum from /photos/:albumId via useParams; reconcile-effect waits for albums.length>0 before deciding to redirect — correct, handles initial load race.

Photos.jsx L658-693 (UploadButton): sequential for-loop over files with single POST /api/photos per file, 60s axios timeout per file, per-file failure capture, and progress.done++ in finally — robust and matches reported fix.

AuthContext.jsx L56-64: logout() is synchronous (clearTokens + setUser(false)) and dispatches /auth/logout via .catch() without await — true fire-and-forget; measured UI latency 120 ms confirms behavior.
backend/routes/photos.py: SpooledTemporaryFile + chunked StreamingResponse confirmed working end-to-end (60 KB zip with valid JPEG entries delivered through the frontend download button).

Minor (non-blocking): after multi-upload, the freshly uploaded photo cards count did not update inline within the 2-second poll window. The 3 POSTs all returned 200 and onDone?.() is invoked; if the parent's loadPhotos refresh feels too delayed for some users, consider awaiting a small setTimeout(0) or explicit await loadPhotos(activeAlbum.name) before resetting busy state. This does NOT regress the P0 fix — only a UX polish suggestion.
